outcome: Postoperative scar healing outcomes (keloid or hypertrophic scarring)
cohort: Forty-six patients with epidermolysis bullosa (EB) who completed a questionnaire regarding a total of 94 different surgical procedures.
finding: Blistering, wound infections, and dehiscence at postoperative sites appear uncommon in patients with EB, particularly unlikely in localized forms, but patients with EB may have a propensity to develop keloid or hypertrophic scarring.
cross-section timing: Outcomes for past surgical procedures were self-reported by patients via a questionnaire at a single point in time.
